import torch
def check():
    k, capacity = 5120, 4096
    stride = k + k // 32
    x = torch.randn(capacity, k, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
    x[0].zero_()
    x[1].mul_(1e-7)
    x[2].mul_(1e-4)
    x[3].mul_(300)
    wire = torch.full((capacity + 1, stride), 255, device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
    unused = torch.full((16,), 93, device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)

    import ctypes as c
    lib=c.CDLL('/native/libds41rt_native.so')
    init=lib.ds41rt_v41_expert_input_quant_initialize
    init.argtypes=[c.POINTER(c.c_void_p)]
    quant=lib.ds41rt_v41_expert_input_quantize_async
    quant.argtypes=[c.c_void_p,c.c_void_p,c.c_void_p,c.c_uint32,c.c_void_p]
    handle=c.c_void_p();assert init(c.byref(handle))==0 and handle.value
    def run(rows):
        assert quant(handle,x.data_ptr(),wire.data_ptr(),rows,torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream)==0
    for inp,out,rows in [(x.data_ptr(),wire.data_ptr(),0),(x.data_ptr(),wire.data_ptr(),4097),
                         (x.data_ptr()+1,wire.data_ptr(),1),(x.data_ptr(),x.data_ptr(),1)]:
        assert quant(handle,inp,out,rows,torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream)!=0
    for rows in [1, 2, 6, 16, 80, 256, 4096, 1]:
        wire.fill_(255)
        run(rows)
        blocks = x[:rows].float().reshape(rows, -1, 32)
        exponent = torch.ceil(torch.log2(blocks.abs().amax(-1).clamp_min(1e-4)/448))
        payload = (blocks/torch.exp2(exponent)[..., None]).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn).view(torch.uint8)
        torch.testing.assert_close(wire[:rows, :k], payload.reshape(rows, k), atol=0, rtol=0)
        torch.testing.assert_close(wire[:rows, k:], (exponent+127).to(torch.uint8), atol=0, rtol=0)
        assert (wire[rows:] == 255).all()
        assert (unused == 93).all()
    x[:6].fill_(1)
    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
        run(6)
    graph.replay()
    assert (wire[:6, :k] != 0).all()
    x[:6].zero_()
    before = torch.cuda.memory_allocated()
    graph.replay()
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    assert torch.cuda.memory_allocated() == before
    assert (wire[:6, :k] == 0).all()
    assert (wire[:6, k:] == 105).all()
    assert (unused == 93).all()

check()
print("PASS native C ABI wire quantization, runtime rows 1..4096, tails, changed-input graph, invalid extents/alignment/overlap")

import subprocess
commands=subprocess.check_output(['ninja','-t','commands','libds41rt_native.so'],cwd='/audit/cmake',text=True).splitlines()
compile_command=next(c for c in commands if ' -c ' in c and '/native/src/v41_experts.cc' in c)
link_command=next(c for c in reversed(commands) if ' -shared ' in c and '-o libds41rt_native.so' in c)
assert ' -o libds41rt_native.so ' in link_command
link_command = link_command.replace(' -o libds41rt_native.so ', ' /audit/cmake/v41_experts/v41_expert_input_quant.o -o libds41rt_native.so ', 1)
for command in (compile_command,link_command):
    subprocess.run(command,cwd='/audit/cmake',shell=True,check=True)
